claims.summary: The dialogue runtime scans exact known model-control markers and preserves only markers with declared delimiter or following-relation evidence.
claims.disposition: Verified against the exact report-bound source SHA-256. The same 1,038-line source was read fully in round 84, and its current hash is unchanged.

claims.summary: The delimiter-depth bound could mishandle a marker wrapped by a fifth delimiter pair.
claims.disposition: Verified existing bounded behavior. The depth limit caps the evidence receipt at four proven outward pairs rather than measuring character distance; the exact five-pair regression preserves the marker and reports depth four.

claims.summary: Unlisted following words such as appears_as or triggers should leave reference_syntax absent and remove only the unframed marker.
claims.disposition: Implemented the missing exact appears_as regression. It remains one underscore-bearing word, is outside the finite allowlist, removes only the marker, and records none_cleanup_candidate. The existing exact triggers regression proves the same boundary.

claims.summary: Common Markdown or LLM formatting should not make an unsupported delimiter leak or preserve a structural marker.
claims.disposition: Backticks are already a declared exact quote pair and preserve the marker. A new Markdown-emphasis regression proves that double asterisks are not silently promoted to quote syntax: the marker is removed and the surrounding asterisks and prose remain exact.

claims.summary: The canonical report covered only source lines 1-400 of a 1,038-line file.
